lines: Devang Mehta, Investor Selling Shareholder, may receive up to ₹2.25 crore if all offered shares are sold; offer price shown, employee-portion shares sell at a discount.
Proceeds are already in hand, received 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago), so timing is past rather than pending.
The trigger is recent: shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, making this a timely conversation.
Retained holding is an estimate of ₹5.25 crore at offer price; the up to ₹1.66 crore gain is before offer expenses and taxes.
